rev.t: Had an amazing time at KAGS Funzone! The bowling, arcade games, VR experiences, and laser tag made it a perfect outing with friends. The place is well-maintained, the staff is friendly, and there’s something fun for every age group. Definitely one of the best indoor entertainment spots in Bangalore for a fun-filled day. 🎳 …
